pages.text: Ore clusters are where Akaishi Crystals come from — and the very start of your tech line: mine a cluster $(bold)with a pickaxe and crystals drop straight out$(0), no smelting, no machinery.$(br2)$(bold)Where to find them:$(0) the Overworld (stone and deepslate layers), the Nether and the End all host them.$(br2)$(4)Newbie advice:$(0) mine every cluster you see — $(e)you need a pickaxe$(0) for anything to drop. Bank a full stack of crystals first; refining and power generation both depend on them.

There are $(bold)16 kinds$(0) of cluster: 4 environments (Overworld / Deepslate / Nether / End) × 4 density grades.$(br2)$(bold)The four grades:$(0)$(li)Low-Density — most common, 1 crystal per block$(li)Medium-Density — 2 crystals$(li)Perfect — 3 crystals$(li)Flawless — rarest, 4 crystals$(br2)$(bold)Drops are fixed:$(0) Fortune does nothing here, so skip the enchant; Silk Touch lets you carry the whole cluster home.$(br2)$(4)Richer means rarer$(0) — to turn what you mine into essence and ingots, read "$(l:akaishi:crystal)Crystal & Essence$(/l)".

Ore runs out, crystals don't: Akaishi Crystal Geodes (akaishi_geode_*) sprout clusters on their own, and a Catalyst plus a Collector turn that into mass production — see the Advanced chapter. For now, feed what you mine into the Purifier and cash it in as essence.
